BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                        OF THE STATE OF MISSOURI

In the Matter of Evergy Metro, Inc. d/b/a Evergy         )
Missouri Metro’s Request for Authority to Implement      )      File No. ER-2026-0143
a General Rate Increase for Electric Service             )

                         NOTICE KAREN LYONS ERRATA SHEET

1.    Exhibit 140, Rebuttal Testimony of Karen Lyons
        i.   Removal of the confidential designation per agreement by Evergy Missouri
             Metro. Removal of this designation impacts the table on Page 10. The full
             contents of the table are included here. The are no other confidential
             markings in the Rebuttal Testimony of Karen Lyons, filed on August 11, 2026.

              Please note the updates further below include immaterial changes to the
              numbers in this table as originally included and pictured here.




        ii.   Page 10, Line 18: “2018-2023” should be “2023-June 2026”.

       iii.   Page 10, Line 23: removal of confidential designation for the table included at
              lines 24-25 (pictured above).

       iv.    Page 10, Line 25: “$4,217,097” should be “$4,216,892”.

        v.    Page 10, Line 25: column heading of “2026 through May” should be “2026
              through June”; and “$1,802,088” should be “$1,958,815”.

       vi.    Page 10, line 26: removal of confidential designation for the table included at
              lines 24-25 (pictured above).

       vii.   Page 11, Line 1: “$4,491,948” should be “$4,491,745”.




                                             1
                                                       Respectfully submitted,

                                                      /s/ Tracy D. Johnson
